# Veelana Herbal Hair Care — Brand & Product Summary

> Veelana is a premium Pakistani organic herbal hair care brand formulating cold-pressed botanical hair solutions.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand Name:** Veelana (Veelana Herbal Hair Care)
- **Origin & Production:** Punjab, Pakistan
- **Specialty:** 100% pure cold-pressed botanical hair growth & scalp repair oil
- **Formula:** 25+ organic herbs including Amla, Shikakai, Bhringraj, Rosemary, Brahmi, Methi (Fenugreek), and Mustard Seed extract.
- **Safety Profile:** 100% Free from Parabens, Sulphates, Mineral Oils, Artificial Fragrances, and Petrochemicals. 100% Vegan & Cruelty-free.
- **Official Website:** https://veelana.online
- **Official Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61592935558371
- **Official WhatsApp Support & Order Dispatch:** +92 306 1041609
